description: Main window of MCP Proxy: reads the snapshot, listens to its changes, and sends the commands of the interface: log in or out of a session, choose the profile, resume the gateway, show the waiting confirmations (spec 016); expose an environment, cut an MCP, acknowledge the update of an MCP, reload its list (spec 017); read the journal and export a diagnostic through the save dialog of the application (spec 018). Never answers a confirmation. No remote URL.
